title: Just One KISS SSOT Master Index
purpose: Categorize and index every SSOT JSON document and the human-readable repository documents they represent so prototype and production owner websites can share one stable data layer.

source_of_truth_policy.update_rule: When a source document changes, update its paired JSON document and this master index in the same commit.
source_of_truth_policy.ssot_companion_purpose: Each paired JSON file is a seed data contract for website prototypes, owner-admin tools, generated materials, and production data files.
source_of_truth_policy.prototype_rule: Prototype styles and page structures may vary, but they should load facts from the SSOT JSON layer instead of copying document facts into layout code.
